sync.intro: Open this page on the shop PC, in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome, and connect the folder your stock software exports to. While the page is open (minimised is fine) it checks the folder every 15 minutes and sends the newest stock file to PPI. PPI only reads that one folder and changes nothing on the PC.

sync.install_intro: Install PPI as an app, then let it start with Windows, so the folder is checked even after a restart.

sync.install_manual: No button? In Edge: menu (⋯) → Apps → Install this site as an app. In Chrome: menu (⋮) → Cast, save and share → Install page as app.
sync.autostart_title: Open PPI automatically when Windows starts:
sync.autostart_1: Start → All apps → right-click “PPI” → More → Open file location.
sync.autostart_2: Select the “PPI” shortcut and copy it (Ctrl+C).
sync.autostart_3: Press Windows+R, type shell:startup and press Enter.
sync.autostart_4: Paste the shortcut into the folder that opens (Ctrl+V).
sync.keep_awake: The PC must not go to sleep during opening hours: Settings → System → Power → Sleep: Never.

privacy_assistant.title: Privacy in the shop assistant
privacy_assistant.draft: Draft text – the final wording is being prepared.
privacy_assistant.what: If the shop has the Pro plan, every conversation with its assistant is stored: your messages, the assistant's answers with the items it showed you (name, price and availability at that moment) and the files you send. Location data (GPS) is removed from photos. Access keys are never stored in the conversation.
privacy_assistant.who: Only the owners of this shop, in My shop. Other shops and visitors cannot see it.
privacy_assistant.time: A conversation ends after 30 minutes without a message or when you close the chat. The shop keeps it for 30, 90 or 365 days (its own setting, 90 days if not set); then it is deleted with its files.
privacy_assistant.delete: While the chat is open, you can delete the conversation and files with “Delete my conversation”. Later, please ask the shop directly.
privacy_assistant.external: When Cacaduu's main search finds too little, it also asks other services: shops nearby from OpenStreetMap (and Google Maps, when switched on) and offers on larger shops' websites (Anthropic's web search). It sends them only the product and the town from your question, nothing else about you. We never find out your location.
privacy_assistant.external_partners: “Partners” offers come from partner shops' product feeds, which Cacaduu reads on its own server. Nothing about you is sent to partners when you search; only you open a partner's link. Affiliate links are marked “partner link” and never change the order of the results.
privacy_assistant.external_todo: TODO (legal text): the services the main search sends the product and the town to – OpenStreetMap Foundation (Nominatim, Overpass API), Google (Places API, when switched on), Anthropic (Claude and its web search).

cloud.error_app_dropbox: Dropbox refused the app's secret. In Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets set DROPBOX_APP_SECRET to the "App secret" from dropbox.com/developers/apps → your app → Settings (Show), then connect again.
cloud.error_app_onedrive: Microsoft refused the app's secret (it may have expired). In Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets set ONEDRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET to the "Value" of a new client secret (Microsoft Entra → App registrations → Certificates & secrets), then connect again.
cloud.error_scope_dropbox: The Dropbox app lacks a permission (writing files). dropbox.com/developers/apps → your app → Permissions → tick files.metadata.read and files.content.write → Submit. Then Connect Dropbox again and Allow.
cloud.error_scope_onedrive: The OneDrive app lacks a permission. In Microsoft Entra → App registrations → API permissions add Files.ReadWrite and offline_access, then Connect OneDrive again.
cloud.error_platform_onedrive: Microsoft refused the sign-in: the redirect address must be under the "Web" platform. Microsoft Entra → App registrations → Cacaduu PPI → Authentication: remove …/cloud-export/oauth/onedrive from "Single-page application" (or "Mobile and desktop"), add it with Add a platform → Web, set "Allow public client flows" to No → Save. Then Connect OneDrive again.
cloud.error_audience_onedrive: The Microsoft app does not let in this kind of account. Microsoft Entra → App registrations → Cacaduu PPI → Authentication → Supported account types: "Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts" → Save. Then Connect OneDrive again.

domains.findable_title: Get found on Google and by AI assistants
domains.findable_intro: The site on {domain} has its own sitemap.xml, robots.txt and llms.txt. Verify it with Google and Bing here and add your product categories.
domains.google_step1: Open Google Search Console, click Add property, choose Domain and enter {domain}.
domains.google_step2: Google shows a TXT record that starts with “google-site-verification=”. Copy it and paste it here.
domains.google_step3: Then click Verify in Search Console.
domains.google_auto_note: Cacaduu writes the record into your domain's DNS itself. Other records (e-mail MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and other TXT) are never changed or removed.
domains.google_manual_note: Your registrar runs this domain: we show you the record and you add it there.
domains.google_added: The TXT record is in the DNS of {domain}. Click Verify in Search Console (a DNS change can take a few minutes to show).
domains.google_manual: Add this record for {domain} at your registrar, then click Verify in Search Console:
domains.google_manual_keep: Do not change or remove existing records (especially MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC), or e-mail may stop working.
domains.google_invalid: This is not the TXT value from Search Console. Copy the whole record that starts with “google-site-verification=”.
domains.google_too_many: The domain already has 5 Google verification records. Write to us if you need another one.
domains.google_too_soon: Wait a moment and try again.
domains.google_meta_step1: Open Google Search Console, click Add property, choose URL prefix and enter {url}.
domains.google_meta_step2: Under other verification methods choose HTML tag, copy the whole <meta name="google-site-verification" …> tag and paste it here.
domains.google_meta_step3: Save the tag, then click Verify in Search Console.
domains.google_txt_text: To verify the whole domain (a Domain property), add a TXT record at your registrar. Paste the value from Search Console here and we show you the exact record.
domains.google_present: This value is already in the DNS of {domain} — we added nothing. Click Verify in Search Console.
domains.google_remove_note_added: Remove deletes from the DNS only this one record, the one Cacaduu added. Every other record stays.
domains.google_remove_note_other: Remove deletes nothing from the DNS (Cacaduu did not add this record); we just stop showing it here.
domains.google_removed_dns: The record Cacaduu added is removed from the DNS. No other record was changed.
domains.google_removed: The value is removed. The DNS was not changed.
domains.bing_import: Easiest: if the domain is already verified in Google Search Console, choose Import in Bing Webmaster Tools and sign in with your Google account — Bing takes it over with its sitemap. Then there is nothing to paste here.
domains.bing_step1: Otherwise add the site {url} in Bing Webmaster Tools.
domains.bing_step2: Choose HTML Meta Tag, copy the whole <meta name="msvalidate.01" …> tag and paste it here.
domains.bing_step3: Save the tag, then click Verify in Bing Webmaster Tools.
domains.bing_label: HTML tag from Bing Webmaster Tools
domains.meta_note: We add the tag only to your shop's pages on {domain}. Keep it after verifying — Google and Bing check it again later.
domains.meta_current: The pages on {domain} carry this tag:
domains.meta_google_saved: The Google tag is on the pages of {domain}. Click Verify in Search Console.
domains.meta_bing_saved: The Bing tag is on the pages of {domain}. Click Verify in Bing Webmaster Tools.
domains.meta_removed: The tag is removed from the pages.
domains.meta_google_invalid: This is not the tag from Search Console. Copy the whole <meta name="google-site-verification" content="…"> tag.
domains.meta_bing_invalid: This is not the tag from Bing Webmaster Tools. Copy the whole <meta name="msvalidate.01" content="…"> tag.
domains.sitemap_bing_step1: Once the site is verified in Bing Webmaster Tools, open Sitemaps and click Submit sitemap.
domains.sitemap_step1: Once the domain is verified in Search Console, open Sitemaps in the menu on the left.
domains.sitemap_step2: Type sitemap.xml into Add a new sitemap and click Submit.
domains.sitemap_step3: Google then reads the pages of all your products regularly by itself.
domains.ai_text: llms.txt describes your shop for AI assistants: name, address, opening hours, categories, the sitemap and how to read the stock. robots.txt lets search engines and AI assistants read the public pages — never My shop, private folders or content behind an access key.

domains.categories_error: The categories could not be saved: at most 12, each at most 40 characters.
domains.indexnow_title: Faster in Bing and other search engines (IndexNow)
domains.indexnow_text: After a stock upload we tell Bing, Seznam, Yandex and others which products changed (a new or removed product, another price, back in stock or sold out) — at most once per upload and once an hour, only the changed pages. Nothing to set up.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draft: Draft. TODO: Cacaduu's final (legally checked) text replaces this draft – the texts are in privacy.* in the three message files.
privacy.who: Cacaduu PPI runs the website on which local shops publish their stock, opening hours and news. TODO: the operator's name, address, company ID, contact.
privacy.visitors: The pages use no advertising or tracking scripts and never ask for your location. Search sends only the words you type. Details about a shop's AI assistant are on the assistant privacy page. A YouTube video loads only after a tap on ▶ (via youtube-nocookie.com); until then nothing loads from YouTube.
privacy.owners: We keep the account's e-mail and password (the password only as a hash), the shop's details and the files the owner uploads. TODO: retention, rights.
privacy.facebook: When a shop owner connects their Facebook Page, Cacaduu gets access to that Page (permissions pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts). From the Page we download only its own posts: text, time, link, photos (stored as WebP), shared links and the pictures of videos with a link. We never download comments, reactions or other people's names. The Page's access token is stored only encrypted and is deleted with "Disconnect". We publish on Facebook only an article the owner explicitly publishes with "Web + Facebook". The public pages have no Facebook scripts, pixels or embedded elements.
privacy.deletion_link: How to delete data from Facebook
privacy.contact: TODO: e-mail for questions about personal data.
privacy.deletion_intro: To delete the data Cacaduu PPI received from a shop's Facebook Page:
privacy.deletion_step1: Log in to Cacaduu PPI → My shop → News / Blog → Facebook Page → "Disconnect". The Page's access token is deleted at once and nothing more is downloaded from the Page.
privacy.deletion_step2: Delete downloaded posts in the list of articles with "Delete" (their photos are deleted too). Delete the whole shop with its data in My shop → Delete shop.
privacy.deletion_step3: On Facebook you can also remove the Cacaduu PPI app in Settings → Business Integrations.
privacy.deletion_contact: If you cannot log in, write to us and we delete the data within 30 days. TODO: e-mail.

content.error_picture_big: The picture “{name}” is still larger than {mb} MB after resizing. Use a smaller picture.
content.error_too_small: The picture “{name}” is too small. Upload at least 800 px wide.
content.error_dates: The “until” date must be the same as or later than the “from” date.
content.error_limit: The library is full. Delete a file.
content.ok_uploaded: Done – the file is in the library.
content.video_target_post: The article on Cacaduu (recommended) – a YouTube video plays right in the article
content.video_target_facebook: The post on Facebook – on a phone in the Facebook app, if the visitor has it
content.video_target_hint: Applies to Facebook videos and to YouTube videos shared on Facebook. An article that is not on Facebook always opens on Cacaduu. The title and "Read" always lead to the article.

translation.original_shown: You are seeing the shop's original texts.
translation.translating: Translating… Until the translation is ready, some texts are in the shop's language.
translation.legal_machine: Machine translation – the Slovak version is binding.

owner_tr.page_intro: The language you write in, the languages of your stock files and the languages Cacaduu translates your page into in advance. Your original texts never change – translations are stored separately and labelled.
owner_tr.unavailable: Languages and translations become available after database update 40.
owner_tr.main_help: The language you write names, descriptions and news in. Everything is translated from it. Example: Slovak – “Farba fasádna biela 5 l” stays exactly so, and in German it shows as “Fassadenfarbe weiß 5 l”.
owner_tr.inventory_help: The languages you send stock files in (besides the main one). Example: you also send a Hungarian file – the Hungarian names then show as “From the shop” and Cacaduu never overwrites them.
owner_tr.preferred_limit: Your plan: at most {n} languages besides the main one.
owner_tr.preferred_help: These languages are translated in advance, come first in the language picker and are found by search engines. Other languages are translated on the first visit. Example: Hungarian and German for a shop near the border.
owner_tr.domain_label: Default language on your own domain
owner_tr.domain_help: The “/” address of your own domain opens in this language on a first visit. Example: Hungarian – davide.sk opens in Hungarian, Slovak is at davide.sk/sk.
owner_tr.auto_help: Off: every AI description waits as a “Description draft” until you approve it. On: it goes live at once. Example: with 500 products you can publish all and fix only those that need it.
owner_tr.translations_summary: Every text of the shop in every language
owner_tr.translations_intro: Product names, descriptions and categories, the assistant's texts, opening-hours notes, slider titles and news. Each shows its state: From the shop, AI, Edited by hand, Outdated, Missing or Do not translate.
owner_tr.describe_bulk_help: A description for products that have none (up to 20 at once), only from your data.
owner_tr.ok_description_choice: Saved – the page shows the chosen description.
owner_tr.err_languages_main: Choose the main language from the list.
owner_tr.err_languages_langs: One of the languages is not switched on.
owner_tr.err_languages_limit: Your plan allows fewer preferred languages. Untick some.
owner_tr.err_languages_domain: This language is not switched on.
owner_tr.err_description_too_long: A description can have at most 3000 characters.
owner_tr.err_descriptions_none: Every product already has a description or a draft.
owner_tr.err_descriptions_failed: The description could not be prepared. Try again.
owner_tr.err_descriptions_few_facts: There is too little data about the product for an honest description.
owner_tr.shop_description_none: Your stock file does not describe this product.
owner_tr.shop_description_help: From your stock file (the “Description” column). Cacaduu never changes it.
owner_tr.draft_help: Written by AI only from your data (name, brand, category, your description) in {lang}. Edit and publish it, or discard it.
owner_tr.describe_help: It invents nothing: with little data the description is short.
owner_tr.show_auto: Automatically – the shop's description if there is one, else Description (Cacaduu)
owner_tr.item_translations_intro: This product's name, description and category in every language. AI never overwrites translations from the shop or your own edits – it can only suggest a new translation.

table.delete_again: translate again on the next visit
table.delete_never: do not translate this product into this language

owner_tr.files_summary: Preview, encoding and a second file in another language

files.preview_title: Preview – the first rows of the columns that will be read
files.matched: Matched products: {n} – their texts are marked “From the shop”.
files.conflicts: Differences in quantity or price: {n} (the main file counts)
files.conflict_row: {item}: here {quantity} pcs / {price}, in the main file {main_quantity} pcs / {main_price}
files.main_done: The main file is processed ({status}, products: {items}).
files.help: You see a preview first: the encoding the file is read in (UTF-8, Windows-1250, Windows-1258 for Vietnamese, GB18030 for Chinese …) and its first rows. A second file in another language is matched by code, then by EAN; quantity and price come only from the main file. Example: a Slovak main file and a Hungarian file with the same codes.

owner_tr.columns_lang_help: If your file has, for example, a column “Názov HU”, choose it, the field “Item name” and the language Hungarian. We suggest them from the column names and remember them. These texts show as “From the shop” and never change.

admin_tr.title: Translations (admin)
admin_tr.intro: The website's languages, the interface texts in further languages and the translation limits. Slovak is the source; the Slovak, Hungarian and English texts are in the repository.
admin_tr.languages_help: A switched-on language is in the language picker. Pre-translated = in hreflang and the sitemap; the others are translated on the first visit and get noindex.
admin_tr.ui_help: The texts of buttons, headings and messages in further languages. A missing text shows in English, then Slovak – never a key name. Legal texts carry “Machine translation – the Slovak version is binding” until you mark them checked.
admin_tr.limits_help: How many preferred languages (besides the main one) a shop may have translated in advance.
admin_tr.budget_help: The monthly budget is the secret TRANSLATION_MONTHLY_BUDGET_EUR (Supabase); at 80 % an e-mail goes to ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL, at 100 % new translations stop until the next month.
